When Headaches Signal a Serious Problem
Seek Urgent Medical Evaluation If: - Your headache occurs after a head
injury. - The headache is accompanied by fever, stiff neck, confusion, or
speech difficulty. - It is the 'worst headache of your life'
(thunderclap). - Pain worsens despite rest and hydration after 48 hours.
